verdict.rationale: Vue's docs describe the framework as 'incrementally adoptable' and able to scale between a library and a full framework. Community reports back this up: Vue can 'spruce up' old applications by selectively adding it to templates, and you can just download vue.min.js with no package manager or bundler. One commenter calls it a jQuery successor. missing for 10: first-party documentation showing how to mount components into existing server-rendered markup (CDN/script-tag usage, multiple mount points), and current hands-on corroboration for Vue 3.
